text:
Sana: quick heads-up — found a tokenizer-induced embedding drift when comparing tokenizer-v1.3 -> v2.0 on the holdout. want to canonicalize token snapshots and refresh a small micro-golden before we flip models for onboarding.

Evan: ugh. symptoms?

Sana: short: token splits changed for contractions and some punctuation, which shifted n-gram positions and caused embed cosine drops ~0.12 for ~1.6% of samples. This affects reranker features and quant smoke comparators.

Priya: do we have a reproducible script to collect token snapshots + embeds?

Sana: yes. running a conservative pass: dedupe with fuzzyhash 0.90, keep annotated gold, sample 280 candidates for triage, build 180-item micro-golden. leaving original raw_text in provenance.

Sana: command i'm using on staging:

```
python3 infra/sample_and_snapshot.py \
  --input s3://seedbanks/promptset_2025/merged.jsonl \
  --out s3://redwood-pruned/token_drift/1789997777/sample.jsonl \
  --tok-versions v1.3,v2.0 \
  --embed-model embed-small-v2 \
  --fuzzy-thresh 0.90 \
  --sample 280 \
  --micro-golden 180 \
  --keep-gold
```

Tom: landing path for label jobs?

Sana: s3://redwood-label-jobs/token-drift/1789997777/. each record will include id, raw_text, tok_v1, tok_v2, tok_diff_note, embed_v1, embed_v2, fuzzy_hash, provenance_url. label ui expects that schema.

labeler-bot: queue status: pending_jobs=1, running_jobs=3, online=[Rina, Omar, Jess]. avg=7m/item.

Rina: I'll take the canary (60) + help adjudicate disagreements. prefer to batch long-context first.

Evan: QA note — include quant int8 and int4 smoke runs against the micro-golden, plus fp16 baseline. capture model commit sha and quant config in metadata.

Sana: yup. we'll tag everything with model_sha, tokenizer_tag, quant_config. also snapshot the reranker weights if we enable reranker in those runs.

SRE: sampler job created: batch-job=bdg-178999A. ephemeral cache mounted at /var/lib/token_cache. logs: https://internal.logs/bdg-178999A. if you need q-embed nodes, request nodepool=qembed.

Priya: adjudication rules?

Sana: 3-vote scheme. fields for labelers: gold_ok/gold_bad, failure_reason (token-split/hallucination/format/PII), severity (low/med/high), notes. items with >=2 gold_bad go to senior-adjudicator. disagreements >20% flagged for review.

Tom: micro-golden composition suggestion: 50 long-context (>1024), 40 ambiguous intent, 40 tokenizer-edge (emoji/ligatures), 30 code-snippets, 20 low-resource-language. sprinkle 15 adversarial probes.

Rina: agreed. will prioritize token-edge & low-resource first.

labeler-bot: canary_uploaded=60, labeling_jobs_created=2

Sana: timeline: canary (60) -> labelers 24h -> adjudicate 12h -> freeze 180 micro-golden -> run quant smokes (2 GPUs) -> full sample labeling in 400-item batches.

Evan: please also persist token counts and byte offsets for v1/v2 in metadata — helps when we inspect attention patterns later.

Sana: included. snapshots go to s3://redwood-token-snaps/1789997777/. embed snapshots to s3://redwood-embeds/token_drift/1789997777/.

SRE: batch job completed partial: processed=120/280, exit=0 so far. next run scheduled for remainder.

QA: will queue quant smoke tests once micro-golden freeze posted. please attach exact model SHA.

Sana: action items:
- SRE: finish batch run + post final logs (in progress)
- Rina/Omar/Jess: label canary (60) within 24h, tag disagreements
- Priya: coordinate senior-adjudicators and schedule 2pm adjudication slot
- Evan: prepare quant-smoke config matrix and alloc GPUs
- Tom: add reranker ON/OFF comparison to eval matrix (small subset)
- Sana: post micro-golden freeze artifact + link to snapshots

Sana: thanks all — will update here. :white_check_mark:
